name: joshuaswarren/omarchy-mlx
title: omarchy-mlx brings Linux MLX inference on Apple Silicon to parity with macOS
summary: On Linux on Apple Silicon, omarchy-mlx now runs Qwen3.8-2B at 215 tok/s on an M2 Max (213 on macOS) and Qwen3-4B at 105 tok/s on an M1 Max (104 on macOS); a fix for slow M5 Max runs is up for testing. MIT repo.
